title: 16 kHz audio
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=16000 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -ar 16000 -ac 1 -t 2

title: 22.05 kHz audio
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=22050 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -ar 22050 -ac 1 -t 2

title: 32 kHz audio
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=sin(440*2*PI*t)|sin(660*2*PI*t):s=32000:c=stereo -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -ar 32000 -t 2

title: WMV2 (Windows Media Video 8) in ASF
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=sin(440*2*PI*t)|sin(660*2*PI*t):s=48000:c=stereo -c:v wmv2 -b:v 1M -c:a wmav2 -f asf -t 2

title: WMV3 / VC-1 Simple Main in WMV container (wmv2; vc1 encoder not in upstream ffmpeg)
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=sin(440*2*PI*t)|sin(660*2*PI*t):s=48000:c=stereo -c:v wmv2 -b:v 1M -c:a wmav2 -f asf -t 2

title: VC-1 Advanced Profile in MKV (wmv2 stand-in)
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=sin(440*2*PI*t)|sin(660*2*PI*t):s=48000:c=stereo -c:v wmv2 -b:v 1M -c:a ac3 -b:a 192k -t 2

title: VC-1 Main Profile in ASF/WMV (wmv2 stand-in)
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=sin(440*2*PI*t)|sin(660*2*PI*t):s=48000:c=stereo -c:v wmv2 -b:v 1M -c:a wmav2 -f asf -t 2

title: VC-1 Advanced + WMA stereo (wmv2 stand-in; wmav2 max 2 channels)
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=sin(440*2*PI*t)|sin(660*2*PI*t):s=48000:c=stereo -c:v wmv2 -b:v 1M -c:a wmav2 -ac 2 -f asf -t 2

title: Theora + Vorbis (OGV)
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=sin(440*2*PI*t)|sin(660*2*PI*t):s=48000:c=stereo -c:v libtheora -q:v 5 -c:a vorbis -strict experimental -t 2

title: Theora low bitrate
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000 -c:v libtheora -b:v 100k -c:a vorbis -strict experimental -t 2

title: Theora YUV422
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=sin(440*2*PI*t)|sin(660*2*PI*t):s=48000:c=stereo -c:v libtheora -pix_fmt yuv422p -q:v 5 -c:a vorbis -strict experimental -t 2

title: AVCHD H.264 High + AC-3 in M2TS (1080p24)
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=1920x1080:rate=24 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=sin(440*2*PI*t)|sin(660*2*PI*t):s=48000:c=stereo -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -pix_fmt yuv420p -b:v 2M -c:a ac3 -b:a 192k -f mpegts -t 2

title: AVCHD 1440x1080 anamorphic + AC-3 5.1
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=1440x1080:rate=30000/1001 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=sin(440*2*PI*t)|sin(660*2*PI*t)|sin(880*2*PI*t)|sin(1100*2*PI*t)|sin(1320*2*PI*t)|sin(1540*2*PI*t):s=48000:c=5.1 -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -pix_fmt yuv420p -b:v 2M -aspect 16:9 -c:a ac3 -b:a 384k -f mpegts -t 2

title: AVCHD 1080i interlaced + AC-3
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=1920x1080:rate=30000/1001 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=sin(440*2*PI*t)|sin(660*2*PI*t):s=48000:c=stereo -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -pix_fmt yuv420p -b:v 2M -flags +ildct+ilme -x264-params tff=1 -c:a ac3 -b:a 192k -f mpegts -t 2

title: VP9 temporal SVC (auto-alt-ref + lag; temporal-layers removed in current libvpx-vp9)
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=sin(440*2*PI*t)|sin(660*2*PI*t):s=48000:c=stereo -c:v libvpx-vp9 -b:v 500k -pix_fmt yuv420p -auto-alt-ref 1 -lag-in-frames 25 -c:a libopus -b:a 96k -t 2

title: VP9 temporal SVC + spatial simulcast-style (2 resolutions)
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=640x360:rate=25 -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=sin(440*2*PI*t)|sin(660*2*PI*t):s=48000:c=stereo -map 0:v -map 1:v -map 2:a -c:v libvpx-vp9 -b:v 500k -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a libopus -b:a 96k -t 2

title: H.264 WebRTC baseline (Annex B, short GOP, repeat SPS/PPS)
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -c:v libx264 -profile:v baseline -pix_fmt yuv420p -g 15 -x264-params repeat-headers=1 -f h264 -t 2

title: H.264 + Opus in MKV (WebRTC-friendly A/V; WebM does not support H.264)
ffmpeg_args: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=sin(440*2*PI*t)|sin(660*2*PI*t):s=48000:c=stereo -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a libopus -b:a 96k -t 2
